description: Customer-facing list menu built from the node's active structured catalog items.

public_catalog.function: Shows a classic customer menu list from the active catalog and posts ordinary order requests to the node.
public_catalog.data_access_summary: Active item ids, names, descriptions, prices, and categories only. It does not own prices, inventory, payment, or operator data.
public_catalog.operator_status: available as the pilot-node customer menu list route when enabled
